title: Characteristic fan criterion for a lifted section homomorphism to be a log chart
statement: Let X be an fs locally Noetherian Zariski log scheme, c its characteristic chart to a fine fan F, x a point, and L a normalized affine localization at c(x) [def-trf-fs-log-blowup] [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup] [lem-trf-fine-fan-point-localization]. Suppose P=P_F,c(x) is fs. For any open U, homomorphism h:P → N_Z(U), and morphism a from the restricted sharp space of X to L, assume a followed by the inclusion is c|U. Assume also that at every y in U and for every p the sharpening of h(p) equals the canonical section of p pulled back along a, as germs on the restricted sharp space. Then h is an etale log chart on U [def-trf-fs-log-blowup]. No marked group section or germ of h at x is prescribed.

source.place: ILO VI 1.1, p.69; VIII 3.1.4(iii), 3.1.8(ii), pp.98--99; 3.3.12, p.108; explicit pushout verification in the parent node, steps 4--5.

proof.text: At a geometric point over y let E be the face of P whose chart images are ring units. The given equality of characteristic germs and factorization through c identify the geometric characteristic with the sharpening of P localized at E, using the actual Zariski and etale unit comparisons.

The associated-log stalk is the pushout P plus_E B^units and the induced map sends [p,u] to h(p)u. Each characteristic class is represented by p/e, so the map is surjective after absorbing h(e) into the unit.

For equal images h(p)u=h(p')u', equality of localized characteristic classes gives e,e' in E with p*e'=p'*e. Integrality gives u*h(e)=u'*h(e'). The defining pushout relations identify the representatives via [p*e',u/h(e')]=[p'*e,u'/h(e)]. Hence the kernel is exactly the pushout congruence. This is IsStalkChart at every geometric point, which is the definition of IsChart.

proof_origin.place: ILO VI 1.1, p.69; VIII 3.1.4(iii), 3.1.8(ii), pp.98--99; 3.3.12, p.108; explicit pushout verification in the parent node, steps 4--5. Explicit subargument of lem-trf-fan-chart-local-monoid-lift.

mathlib_searches.query: A homomorphism to a fine logarithmic structure inducing the prescribed characteristic fan map is a logarithmic chart
mathlib_searches.results: Returned manifold charts, smooth monoid morphisms, and categorical Fan.ext_hom_hom. None is a logarithmic chart criterion.
Twelve elliptic curve normal form results, no logarithmic chart theorem.
Ordinary sheaf stalks and germs, local surjectivity, and sheafification. No logarithmic characteristic comparison, finite monoid lift, or chart criterion.

lean.statement:
theorem fan_chart_section_is_chart
    {X : FineSaturatedLogScheme.{u}} {F : FineFan.Fan.{u}}
    (c : LogFanChart X F) (x : X.scheme)
    (L : FineFan.PointLocalization F (c.map.hom.base x))
    (hP : IsFineSaturatedMonoid
      (FineFan.stalk F.space.presheaf (c.map.hom.base x)))
    (U : X.scheme.Opens)
    (h : FineFan.stalk F.space.presheaf (c.map.hom.base x) →*
      X.logStructure.monoidSheaf.obj.obj (op ((logOpenEtale X.scheme).obj U)))
    (a : X.logStructure.sharpSpace.restrict U.isOpenEmbedding ⟶
      F.space.restrict L.openSet.isOpenEmbedding)
    (ha : a ≫ F.space.ofRestrict L.openSet.isOpenEmbedding =
      X.logStructure.sharpSpace.ofRestrict U.isOpenEmbedding ≫ c.map)
    (hh : ∀ (p : FineFan.stalk F.space.presheaf (c.map.hom.base x))
      (y : X.scheme) (hy : y ∈ U),
      FineFan.stalkMap (X.logStructure.sharpSpace.ofRestrict U.isOpenEmbedding)
          ⟨y, hy⟩ (FineFan.germ X.logStructure.sharpSpace.presheaf U y hy
            (X.logStructure.sharpSection U (h p))) =
        FineFan.germ (X.logStructure.sharpSpace.restrict U.isOpenEmbedding).presheaf
          ⊤ ⟨y, hy⟩ (by trivial) (FineFan.affinePullback (a ≫ L.iso.hom) p)) :
    X.logStructure.IsChart ((logOpenEtale X.scheme).obj U) h
